problem: Residents often learn about local safety issues, lost pets, or urgent community notices too late because information is scattered across group chats, flyers, or word of mouth, leading to missed opportunities to help or stay safe.
solution: A lightweight, mobile‑responsive static website where anyone can post short alerts (e.g., lost pet, road hazard, neighborhood watch tip) that are saved locally and can be shared via a simple URL. The board shows the most recent alerts, allows filtering by category, and works offline using localStorage.

competitors.name: Nextdoor
competitors.difference: Nextdoor requires account creation and aggregates many types of posts; our board is zero‑login, privacy‑first, and focused solely on urgent alerts.

competitors.name: Patch
competitors.difference: Patch is a news platform for towns; it lacks real‑time, user‑generated safety alerts and offline capability.

features: Create, edit, and delete alerts with title, description, category, and optional expiration date
Filter alerts by category (Lost Pet, Safety, Maintenance, Other)
Responsive design works on phones and desktops
All data stored in browser localStorage for privacy and offline use
Shareable URL that loads the current board state via URL‑encoded data

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium “Community Sponsor” badge and custom branding for HOA boards at $5/month per board after 3 months of free use
monetization.free_tier: Unlimited alerts, categories, and sharing for individual residents

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish the repo on GitHub and enable GitHub Pages
Share the link in local community newsletters and on existing neighborhood social groups
Gather feedback from 10 households and iterate UI based on their input

marketing_content.tagline: Stay Informed, Stay Safe – Your Neighborhood’s Real‑Time Alert Board
marketing_content.social_post: 🚨 Introducing Neighborhood Alert Board – a simple, privacy‑first place to post and see local safety alerts, lost pets, and urgent notices. No login, works offline, and completely free. Try it today at https://yourusername.github.io/neighborhood-alert-board

tests: Create a new alert, refresh the page, and verify the alert persists (localStorage).
Use the share button, copy the generated URL, open it in a new incognito window, and confirm the alert list loads from the URL parameter.
Apply a category filter and ensure only matching alerts are displayed.
next_improvements: Add optional password protection for HOA‑managed boards
Enable image upload using base64 for pet photos
Implement a simple serverless function to sync boards across devices (optional paid add‑on)
